subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Do maintainers want the proposed permanent cross-platform question-history behavior and web panel-as-composer interaction as the supported product contract after the reused-ID lifecycle bug is repaired?
rationale: This is a broad user-facing behavior change across native and web clients, not only a mechanical bug fix; the protected maintainer signal and the PR’s stated UX direction require an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Sponsor parity after repair
options.body: Keep the persistent-summary and composer-takeover direction, require freshness-safe reused-ID handling plus mobile runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Land only the independently desired recovery or Skip improvements and defer the permanent history or web composer takeover decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor parity after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the persistent-summary and composer-takeover direction, require freshness-safe reused-ID handling plus mobile runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available cross-platform question-flow history is concentrated in this coordinated implementation, although repository ownership could not be independently confirmed.
